title: MOH Calls on Yet-to-be Enrolled Graduates of Health Diplomas to Attend at the MOH Headquarter
description: > Page Content The Ministry of Health (MOH) calls on the health diplomas graduates referred to it, included among the gracious Royal Decree No. 26736, dated on 22/5/2013 (corresponding to 12/7/1434 H), but did not sign their contracts so far, to urgently visit the MOH Training and Scholarship General Department in Riyadh for signing their contracts. It is worth mentioning that the deadline will be on Tuesday, 1/10/2013 (corresponding to 11/25/1434 H).Applicants are required to submit the following documents: The ID card along with 2 photocopies. The original graduation certificate along with 2 photocopies. The original occupational classification certificate along with 2 photocopies The original classification card along with 2 photocopies. International Bank Account Number (IBAN) on the approved Bank models. 2 personal photos. The Ministry is not to sign with any other trainees after the above-mentioned due date. <menu
